title: Some emails I send are not appearing in my sent folder
creator: alexandra19
content: Usually I send an email to someone and it appears in my sent folder after a few minutes. Recently I sent two emails to contacts I usually email, with attachments. These aren't appearing in my sent folder. I didn't receive a message saying it bounced back and I think it sent because someone I cc'd received the message in their inbox. I don't want to double email my client if they already got it.

title: Spectrum RoadRunner outgoing email no longer working with thunderbird?

content:
